units.source_text: 那应该是个从乡下来的姑娘。

en.t: She must have been a girl from the countryside.

units.source_text: 干枯的头发绾成银杏髻，过分赤红的双颊上，还有一道道皲裂的伤痕。

en.t: Her dry hair was tied in an icho-style bun, and across her excessively red cheeks ran lines of chapped cracks.

units.source_text: 脖子上戴着一条脏兮兮的淡绿色毛线围巾，围巾一直垂到放着一个大包袱的膝盖上。

en.t: Around her neck she wore a dirty pale green woolen scarf, which hung all the way down to her knees where a large bundle rested.

units.source_text: 抱着包袱的手上满是冻疮，手里还谨慎的捏着一张三等车票。

en.t: The hands holding the bundle were covered with chilblains, and in one of them she carefully pinched a third-class ticket.

units.source_text: 这位姑娘俗气的面像和邋遢的打扮都令我感到不快。

en.t: I found both the girl's vulgar face and her slovenly dress unpleasant.

units.source_text: 更令我觉得烦躁的是，她连二等车厢和三等车厢都搞错了。

en.t: What irritated me even more was that she had mixed up the second-class and third-class carriages.

units.source_text: 因为这样，抽上烟之后，为了忽略这个姑娘，我从大衣兜里取出晚报摊在膝盖上。

en.t: So after lighting a cigarette, I took an evening paper from my overcoat pocket and spread it on my knees to ignore the girl.

units.source_text: 此时，照在晚报上的光线突然由窗外的阳光变成车厢内的电灯光，报纸上印刷不清楚的几个字突出的映入眼帘。

en.t: Just then, the light falling on the evening paper suddenly changed from the sunlight outside the window to the electric light inside the carriage, and several indistinctly printed words on the page sprang into view.

units.source_text: 毫无疑问，火车驶进了横须贺线上众多隧道中的第一个隧道。

en.t: Without a doubt, the train had entered the first of the many tunnels on the Yokosuka Line.
